title: Todo List Application
description: An application to manage tasks with functionalities to add, delete, and mark tasks as complete.

features.name: Add Task
features.description: Allows users to add new tasks to their todo list.

features.name: Delete Task
features.description: Enables users to remove tasks from their todo list.

features.name: Complete Task
features.description: Provides functionality to mark tasks as completed.

target_users: Individuals looking to organize and manage their tasks
data_requirements: Requires storage for task data, including task name and status
